headline: Davivienda Opposes Fintech Plata Colombia Over Trademark Dispute
summary: Colombian bank Davivienda is opposing fintech Plata Colombia, giving the digital platform 30 business days to defend its brand following regulatory authorization.
why: Brand disputes and competition between traditional banks and fintechs highlight regulatory hurdles in Latin America's evolving digital financial services market.
